note: Both sets extract the same 19 table values and make the identical misbinding: every value from the R-57.5 rows (17,080; 14,880; 2,423; 459; 2,882; 19,802; 15,852; 2,870; 3,920) is labeled as R-47.5, so each set has 9 misbound claims. Their correct claims are the same 10 values (eQuest and BEoptE+ loads and energy for R-47.5), and both leave the load values vaguely described as 'energy use' rather than heating/cooling load. Set A adds one extra trivial claim (roof insulation R-value 47.5 R) but nothing substantive that Set B lacks; both also omit the 2.08% and 0.51% annual energy increase results. Overall the two extractions are equivalent in accuracy and coverage.
